Narendra vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 16

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8002 of 2021
Applicant :- Narendra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Suresh Chandra Srivastava,Aman Kumar Shrivastav,Savita Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Aman Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri Manish Kumar Pandey, learned Addl. Government Advocate, and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant application the applicant Narendra S/o Sri Laximan seeks bail in Case Crime No. 54 of 2021, under sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4, Dowry Prohibition Act,
P.S. Phardhan, District Lakhimpur Kheri.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 14.03.2021 stating that the informant had got his sister married to the applicant about four years ago; that the applicant used to beat and harass her for demand of dowry and on 13.03.2021 the informant came to know that his sister was killed by hanging her.

4. The postmortem examination report of the dead-body of the informant's sister mentions a ligature mark around her neck and the cause of death has been opined to be Asphyxia as a result of anti-mortem hanging, although some other injuries have also been mentioned on the dead-body.

5. By means of an order dated 13.10.2022 this Court had directed the Trial Court to record Narendra vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10677870/
1 statement of the witnesses of fact within a period of 3 months.
6. A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant annexing therewith the statements of the informant and his another brother Karan recorded by the Trial Court.

None of the witnesses have stated that the applicant used to demand dowry and the P.W.2 has stated that her sister of had received some land in inheritance and she wanted to give the same to her brothers; that the applicant was opposed to it and the deceased committed suicide for the aforesaid reason.
7. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail-application, but has not disputed the aforesaid facts.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the informant and another brother of the deceased have already been examined; that P.W.-2 has categorically stated that the deceased had committed suicide, because the applicant was not agreeing to her wish to gift her land to her brothers, coupled with the fact that the aforesaid witness have not already been examined; the applicant will not be in a position to influence the witnesses, in case the applicant is released on bail, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
10.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

11. Let the applicant Narendra S/o Sri Laximan be released on bail in the aforesaid Case Crime No.
54 of 2021, under sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and section 3/4, Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.
Phardhan, District Lakhimpur Kheri, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
12.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
